quest.title: Docked on a Moonlit Night
quest.description: "Do you know that I met a very nice client today? She moved and talked with grace — a very generous buyer, too." "What did you sell her?" "Trade secret."

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #Ahoy, {NICKNAME}! Great timing. Join us for a round?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Traveler, what a pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, did you two come together?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: This lady decided on a whim that she wanted a little vacation, so we ended up traveling around the area.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But I guess we have different ideas of vacation. We hardly hiked the mountains before we came here to put our feet up. Talk about spoiled.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Come now, no need to hurt anyone's feelings. Besides, I specifically chose this place because I knew how much you like to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But our captain here has seen a lot more of the world, so she's not exactly thrilled with this little tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It'll do. Anyway, this one's on me, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou's paying? Uh, does that include us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're the bartenders, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh right. Hehe, sorry... guess that's just a habit now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what can I get for the two lovely ladies?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I'll have a small Birch Sap, on the sour side.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Uh... I will have a... a large Dusk, please. Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it. Coming right up.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well? H—How is it? This silence is making Paimon nervous!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Mmm... The bittersweet taste of nostalgia.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: You mean the taste of going from rags to riches? Just what kind of taste is that?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Hehe... It's mainly sour with just a tinge of sweetness, and a lingering aftertaste.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Interesting... Does it taste like starting a little business then discovering that selling fruit isn't very lucrative?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: No need to get into the details. Let's leave the past in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha, who'd have thought that the dignified Tianquan was once a fruit vendor on the street.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: On the other hand, I bet few can tell that I'm from an ordinary fishing village, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Not necessarily. If you ask me...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I'd say that Captain Beidou has eyes that can pierce the sea. You're an adventure-seeking pioneer who tames the wind and the waves... Which is clearly indicative of someone who grew up by the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, you're not mocking me, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Come now, it wouldn't do any good to be sarcastic.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I know how fierce you can be with words. It's my treat today, so remember to take it easy on me.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Alright, then I'd like to have a few more.

choices.text: Another drink for the lovely lady?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you heard the good lady, bartender!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I like where this is going! I'll have another round, too!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Mondstadt's fresh fruit juice is hard to top. I wish I could enjoy some every day.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Are you serious? Don't tell me you're gonna open a Sunsettia trade route now...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I'm just joking, of course. There's already a whole industry established for that. They don't need me muscling my way in to their business.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: #Thanks for the drinks today, {NICKNAME}. If you'd ever like a cushy job, I'd enjoy having you as my personal bartender.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: You're also welcome aboard the Alcor. The crew loves to drink, you could come feast with us. I promise you'd have a blast.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: My, my, Captain Beidou, are you competing with me for talent? That's hardly necessary. You may simply stop by the Jade Chamber whenever you want the Traveler to mix you a drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it Paimon, or does it sound like they think you work for them?

choices.text: I'll visit you both. I promise.

talks.objective: Give the drinks to Ningguang and Beidou

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't look like the drink they ordered. Just give this one to Paimon and try making another.
